_coordinates_note: Approximate city centre (George Square). Replace with a verified point before any radius/geo query uses it (Ticketmaster GB, Met Office).
_status: SKELETON (Glasgow Phase 2, 2026-10-22): site-wide noindex ON, every data source and feature disabled. Nothing scrapes or publishes for this town yet. Phase 3 adds sources one by one, each behind its own enabled flag, after reachability and robots/ToS are verified.

identity._terms_note: ai_pipeline/town_guard.py cross-site contamination guard: terms a US town must never mention. Chosen to be unambiguous; display_name (Glasgow) and county (Glasgow City) are added automatically.

compliance._note: Scottish contempt-of-court rule (Phase 5): any item about arrests, charges, sheriff or High Court proceedings or named suspects is held, never auto-published.

city_meetings._notes: Phase 3.1 DONE 2026-10-22: CoInS (Northgate) via scrapers/parsers/glasgow_coins_v1.py. No robots.txt (404), no ToS found, no bot challenge on this host; www.glasgow.gov.uk is behind a Cloudflare challenge and is never touched. 49 meetings incl. 18 Area Partnerships + Licensing Board; agenda item titles only (papers are PDFs, not fetched). Personnel Appeals Committee (dismissal appeals) excluded. enabled:true only means the scraper CAN run: no scrape workflow/cron exists for glasgow yet and nothing has been written to the live DB.

weather._notes: Phase 3.2: needs the owner's DataHub key. The US NWS parsers do not apply.

weather_alerts._notes: Phase 3.2: Met Office warnings + SEPA flood warnings.

traffic._notes: Phase 3.3: DATEX II needs an approved subscription; tellmescotland.gov.uk notices.

sources.name: glasgow_life
sources._note: Phase 3.4a, built 2026-10-22: Glasgow Life (council culture/libraries/sport trust) what's-on cards, scrapers/glasgow_life_events.py. robots.txt allows the paths, no bot challenge, no terms page found; listing pages only (6 requests/day, 2 s apart), facts + link back, no detail pages/images/prices. About 41 distinct events (curated slice, no pagination). Dry-run verified; enabled stays false until the owner approves the first events write to the live DB (the meetings approval did not cover events).

events._notes: Ticketmaster GB is NOT a scraper source: it is fetched at build time by site/src/lib/ticketmaster.ts (latlong search, see site-config ticketmaster block) and is verified separately (phase 3.4b).

jobs._notes: Phase 3.6, verified 2026-10-22: the existing ADZUNA_APP_ID/ADZUNA_APP_KEY work for the gb endpoint (5 336 Glasgow results; dry run of the parser 50 rows, 46 with salary, 24 predicted = flagged est.). GBP, so the site renders pound signs for country gb (lib/jobs.ts) and the parser uses UK title keywords for gb only. One call/day (free tier). enabled stays false until the owner approves the first jobs write to the live DB; the jobs section is also still in disabledSections for glasgow.
